RenoiseScriptingTool.Author: phaos
RenoiseScriptingTool.Name: Simple Xfade
RenoiseScriptingTool.Description: Equal power crossfade loop from one key: select the part to loop in the sample editor and press Crossfade (bind it in Preferences > Keys > Sample Editor > Simple Xfade; also in the sample editor's right-click menu). The audio just before the selection is faded into the loop's end, so it wraps without a click. With nothing selected, the sample's own loop is crossfaded. Crossfade Instrument does the same, with the same selected frames, for every sample of the selected instrument.
